messages:
Alex G: Planning py/ts SDK canary tonight 23:00 PT. Shadow-route 5%, need dist-tag and deprecation blurb signoff.
Sara L: Changelog PR linked and almost ready. Tiny deprec wording nit.
Alex G: Fixed. backend flag `sdk_shadow_route` must be enabled.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @alex at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Jobs queued (builds + publish).
Mike R: I'll run TS smoke at 22:30; hold if renderer fails.
Jen C: Saw flaky render before, will run full smoke and report at 22:40.
Tony S: Pinback commands (if needed): `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.12.4 latest`, `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary`, and curl shadow-route pct=0.
Mike R: Smoke: TS 120/122 pass, 2 timeouts on telemetry. OK to proceed.
Sara L: Docs updated and deprecation note added with migration link.
Alex G: Launch sequence: build wheels, publish canary, add canary tag, shadow-route 5%, monitor 30m -> promote to staged if green.
deploy-bot: publish-canary succeeded. Shadow-route set 5%.
Jen C: 10m metrics: latency within SLO, error-rate 0.08%. No regressions.
Mike R: Minor console warnings tracked in GH #512. Not blocking.
Alex G: Hold rule: abort if customer errors >0.5% or start() regresses.
Sara L: 30m check positive. Approving promotion.
deploy-bot: Promotion to staged triggered by @alex.
Tony S: Reminder to rotate publish token after promote and to run `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.13.0 staged` when promoting.
Alex G: Will publish release notes tomorrow and announce deprecation timeline unless we see regressions. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
